title: LSTM
core_mech: 带门控的加性 cell memory 与 recurrent hidden state 分离，使长期信息可选择性保留和读出。
core_mech_en: Separates an additive linear cell memory state c_t (governed by forget and input gates) from the non-linear recurrent hidden state h_t to preserve long-term temporal gradients.
input_en: Sequential physiological waveform or longitudinal clinical time series x_1 … x_T
output_desc: 逐时刻隐藏状态或序列级预测
output_en: Step-wise hidden states h_t or sequence-level diagnostic prediction

source.title: LSTM
notes: PyTorch implements the modern forget-gate LSTM. The original 1997 LSTM paper did not use this identical cell, so historical architecture changes must be explicit.

adapter.name: LSTM
adapter.mechanism: Input/forget/output gates and an additive memory cell carry information across time.
limitations: Direct modern PyTorch LSTM includes forget gates introduced after the 1997 paper; this historical difference is explicit. Synthetic waves are not ECG/EEG.

verification.title: LSTM
verification.budget_enforcement: cooperative boundary checks; not an OS allocation limit
limitations: Direct modern PyTorch LSTM includes forget gates introduced after the 1997 paper; this historical difference is explicit. Synthetic waves are not ECG/EEG.
verification.isolation: One fresh Python process per model; sequential execution
verification.evidence_note: Original successful execution retained at its original version and date. Executable code and this dataset match the captured release; source registry metadata changed. No model was rerun by this build.

gaps: Original method has no implemented and tested local CPU adapter.
